title: Kennedy delegation tours western nuclear facilities after Cuban missile crisis
summary: Kurt McConnell tells of Kennedy delegation tours western nuclear facilities after Cuban missile crisis, about 1962 at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Los Alamos and western US nuclear installations

plain: A former US Senate staffer named Kirk McConnell, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, tells of a trip after the Cuban missile crisis of 1962, the standoff with the Soviet Union over nuclear missiles in Cuba. McConnell says President John F. Kennedy led a delegation to Los Alamos, a nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico, and other nuclear sites in the western United States, and that a researcher named Jeff Cruikshank has listed who went: Kennedy, Vice President Lyndon Johnson, the national security adviser McGeorge Bundy, and the Air Force general Curtis LeMay. McConnell raises it as a trip whose full purpose, if he is right, may have gone beyond what was publicly said.
